title: Diversity in Acute Hospital Models in Singapore’s Healthcare Landscape
what_it_is: Diversity in Acute Hospital Models in Singapore’s Healthcare Landscape

sections.label: Hospital to serve Singaporeans
sections.summary: The passage states the more important features include requiring the hospital to serve primarily Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Much attention has been given to the proposed not-for-profit feature, but actually, that is not the key feature.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Instead, we think the more important features are: First, the hospital is required to serve primarily Singaporeans.

sections.label: Bill size restrictions
sections.summary: The passage states bill size restrictions will be imposed on the private hospital to avoid a high-cost care model.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Third, cost-effective care – we intend to impose bill size restrictions on the private hospital as we do not want a high-cost care model.

sections.label: Ratio moving to public hospitals
sections.summary: The passage states the ratio has shifted to 90:10 and continues to move towards the public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Today, it has shifted to 90:10 and the ratio continues to move towards the public hospitals.

sections.label: Quality factors for bidders
sections.summary: The passage states quality factors such as serving Singaporeans, affordability by bill sizes and value-based care are put in the tender and used to evaluate bidders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Which is why I mentioned just now that we want to be singularly licensed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: We put in other quality factors such as: primarily for Singaporeans; affordability, which will be measured in terms of bill sizes; as well as value-based care, how you intend to do value-based care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: All these will be taken into account as we had put put in the tender and as we evaluate interested bidders.

sections.label: One more affordable private hospital
sections.summary: The passage states one more affordable private hospital should be accommodated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: In addition, we think we can, we should be able to accommodate one more more affordable private hospital.
